cards.prompt: A calm, symmetrical landscape reflected in a still pond, illustrating 'as above, so below.' In the TOP half: a few simple shimmering trees and a gentle mountain silhouette under a dark starry night sky sprinkled with small four-point stars. In the BOTTOM half: the exact mirror image of all of it — the same trees, mountain and stars — reflected upside-down in smooth dark water. A single clean horizontal waterline runs across the middle so the top and its reflection read as near-perfect mirrors of each other. Flat, simple, calm, generous cream space at the edges. No text.
